units: <cite ref="Eruvin 16b:4-24">Erub. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד … בית סאתים פ׳</he> provided there is not an area of two S’ah unoccupied; expl.

<cite ref="Eruvin 17a:5">ib. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ מכלים</he> unoccupied by travelling implements, contrad. to <he>פ׳ מאדם</he> superfluous as regards the number of travellers (to each of whom an area of two S’ah is assigned).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:16">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>; Tanḥ. Vaëra 6 <he>שבטו … פ׳ היה מעבודת פרך</he> the tribe of Levi was exempt from hard labor; ed. Bub. ib. 4; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 176:2">Yalk. Ex. 176</cite> <he>פְּנוּי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="L00397"><he>לטרגיה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 23a:11">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא יראה בעל הבית שעה פ׳ וכ׳</he> that the owner may not look out for a free moment (when there are no poor about), and say to his poor relative, here is the corner (<cite ref="Q00006"><he>פֵּאָה</he></cite>); Y. Peah IV, 18ᵇ <he>קנויה</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּנוּיִים</he>, <he>פְּנוּיִין</he>; <he>פְּנוּיוֹת</he>. Tanḥ. l. c. <he>בשביל שאתם פ׳ וכ׳</he> because you are idle, you say &c.; Ex. R. l. c. <he>פְּנוּיִם</he>; a. e.

senses.gloss: síngle, unmarríed. Sifra Emor, Par. 1, ch. I הפ׳ הבא על הפ׳ שלא וכ׳ if an unmarried man has connection with an unmarried woman without the intention of thereby making her his wife; Yeb. 61ᵇ; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:14">Num. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <he>מעין חתום</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:12">Cant. IV, 12</cite>) <he>אלו הפנויות</he> this refers to the unmarried (men and women in Egypt). Tanḥ. Vayesheb 8 <he>השתא הפ׳ שלכם אסורות לנו וכ׳</he> even the unmarried of your people are forbidden to us, how much more thou who art a man’s wife; a. fr.
